title: Dock
description: The macOS dock, in vanilla: tiles swell as the cursor approaches and settle as it leaves.
usage: For app launchers and playful navigation. The script measures each tile’s distance from the cursor and scales by proximity — near tiles grow, the wave falls off within about two tiles. Tiles are buttons or links with real names; the label above a hovered tile is its accessible name.
a11y: Magnification is pointer theatre: focus order, names and layout never move, and a keyboard user tabs through ordinary buttons. Under prefers-reduced-motion the wave is off and every tile sits at rest size.
